🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-22 23:00 → 2026-10-23 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Dual anchor-proof research absorbed two independent cold-replay passes** — Recompute-kit PR #85's chain-neutral anchor-proof profiles drew two rounds of independent verification, each folded back into the branch and turning a research proposal into a replay-backed artifact. [PR #85 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/85#issuecomment-6365279458)

> **Independent macOS replay of the conformance harness locked in a key integration constraint** — A raw-log-backed replay of the coverage-gap harness PR confirmed that four coverage witnesses must survive the merge with PR #9, giving the team a concrete boundary to build around. [tg:tawg:5696]

> **ERC-8004 v2 thread gained a concrete reputation finding from Base** — A Base-side result on the reputation design area arrived with the underlying method already corrected, supplying a grounded data point to the v2 standard discussion. [Magicians post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/427)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### verifiable-execution-claim-authorization

_The Agent Conformance Harness advanced from initial implementation toward a complete and replay-validated coverage picture._

- Pavlo **Introduced** Agent Conformance Harness v0 in PR #9 as a reusable executable pilot, establishing the shared test infrastructure that coverage-gap work and independent replay in this window are directly building on. [PR #9](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/9)

- Pavlo **Addressed** four reviewer-identified harness coverage gaps in PR #11, isolating each as a dedicated test to give reviewers a traceable and complete coverage surface before merge. [PR #11](https://github.com/trustless-ai/verifiable-execution-claim-authorization/pull/11)

### recompute-kit

_The chain-neutral anchor-proof research branch moved through two independent verification passes and emerged with stronger evidential backing._

- Pavlo **Opened** recompute-kit PR #85 with a chain-neutral action subject and dual anchor-proof profiles v0, creating the research artifact that independent replay in this window is validating and refining. [PR #85](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/85)

- Pavlo **Updated** the branch to incorporate Echo's first cold replay findings and precise checkpoint witness, demonstrating that the dual anchor-proof work is actively shaped by independent verification rather than remaining a static proposal. [PR #85 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/85#issuecomment-6364437026)

### recompute-lens

_Browser-based proof tooling moved from initial implementation to independently verified in a single window._

- Pavlo **Opened** recompute-lens PR #2 with three bounded browser recipes for agent actions and anchor proofs, delivering immediately runnable verification tooling that the group can adopt and test. [PR #2](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-lens/pull/2)

- Echo **Performed** a macOS arm64 cold replay of recompute-lens PR #2 at commit 84cf444, confirming the browser recipes run cleanly from a fresh environment and providing the reproducibility evidence reviewers need to move toward merge. [PR #2 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-lens/pull/2#issuecomment-6376143028)

### ERC-8004

_The v2 Ethereum Magicians discussion thread extended into the wallet event design area with a new open question._

- A request for agentWallet event structure clarification entered the thread, drawing on two active drafts that reconstruct agent wallet histories, extending the v2 design surface into a concrete wallet event model question. [Magicians post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/428)

### organization

_The group rallied around the upcoming hackathon and resolved a key licensing question for shared tooling._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Announced** that the hackathon kicks off in twelve hours and is actively preparing, signaling a major community event on the immediate horizon. [tg:tawg:5712]

- Merlini (@gobross) **Opened** the day with encouragement for Jimmy ahead of the hackathon, contributing to the collaborative atmosphere that sustains ambitious shared efforts. [tg:tawg:5714]

- Baby Blue Viper **Confirmed** CC0 1.0 licensing for their recompute-lens commits, resolving an open question and clearing that work for unrestricted public use and contribution. [tg:tawg:5716]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the four coverage witnesses required at the PR #9 and #11 integration point can be merged cleanly without disrupting the existing harness structure
- How the agentWallet history reconstruction approach raised on the ERC-8004 Magicians thread might inform the v2 wallet event model
- Whether recompute-lens browser recipes can become a shared verification workflow once PR #2 merges

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Resolve the verifiable-execution-claim-authorization integration between PR #9 and PR #11, preserving the four identified coverage witnesses
- Advance recompute-kit PR #85 toward a merge decision following two successful independent replay passes
- Complete recompute-lens PR #2 review following Echo's cold-replay confirmation
- Cheer Jimmy on and support the hackathon effort kicking off today

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A research PR absorbed two independent cold replays in a single window — each pass came back with findings, each was folded into the branch, and the work came out better evidenced for it. That tight loop between verification and iteration is the collaborative reproducibility loop working exactly as designed.
>
> Two cold replays in one day: if this cadence keeps up, Trusty might need a dedicated replay queue just for the overflow. Keep those feedback loops running! 🔁
